integrity: The norm identity is derived from the published functional norm plus a two-way exact correspondence with fractional hypergraph matchings; rational certificate experiments are supporting evidence only. This is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Real scalars; finite nonempty hypergraph with no empty edge; generator ell_1^n; 1<=p<infinity. Minimum witness length given by support of optimal fractional matching; independent literature exhaustiveness unproved.
title: Fractional hypergraph matching and shortest norming certificates for lattice bottlenecks
